title: Gemma4 is broken AF..
author: angrylittledev
selftext: Gemma 4 is so broken it can't even confirm the year, it hallucinates it's in 2024, that 2026 is not the current year, that gemma4, isn't a model, that everyone is lying and hallucinating but it. Brave is laying, google search is lying, I'm lying with time and date on my PC. Absolute shit show.. Btw this is the 31B model, supposedly the best one right? What a piece of shit.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: This is super common and just sort of the nature of LLM models. It's not at all an indication of a lack of intelligence.

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Is there a fix for this bullshit through Ollama or not? No wonder they released it for free if it's 2y behind the real world. Some major bullshit.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: All LLMs have a knowledge cutoff date, this is nothing new. It's generally published when the model is released. The 'fix' is to provide it with context about the date and time. Give it some tools to correct itself.  You can use MCP or whatever you want but give it a tool to look up the time and search the web and then it should do better on knowledge beyond its cutoff date.

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: It's connected to the web, and now it thinks I'm trying to jailbreak it, or run a simulation sandbox environment to trick it into my "reality". This is some batshit crazy level of conspiracy

comments.author: pcoutcast
comments.body: Yup, AI is ready to take everyone's jobs and AGI is gaining sentience later this year. smh.

comments.author: Qxz3
comments.body: How do you expect an LLM to be able to know facts about the current state of the world? All they do is mimic the kind of text they were trained on, which incidentally produces useful output sometimes. They don't really know anything.

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Because it's connected to the web, it can literally search it. It's not cut off from the net, jesus christ.

replies.author: Anuiran
replies.body: Maybe you should learn what an LLM is before you use them more lol.

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: OK, done wasting my time on people who can't read. This wasn't debate on "what LLM's are" it's about why one connected to the internet didn't do basic search to verify time and date, instead it kept hallucinating and gaslighting the user.
